sprint: Mandatory Dependency Handling Investigation and Fix
summary: Investigated and fixed mandatory dependency handling for LowCode reflection and example generation. Implemented two-part fix: (1) all-TFM group collection for packages missing deps in netstandard2.0 nuspec group, (2) extra_packages config support for internal Aspose assemblies not declared in any nuspec group.

phase_a_preflight.finding: Three families were reflection-blocked: ocr (Aspose.Drawing.Common missing), omr (Newtonsoft.Json missing), psd (Newtonsoft.Json missing). Prior diagnosis of extractor.py resolved-libs gap was incorrect.

confirmed_root_causes.omr: Newtonsoft.Json NOT declared in any nuspec group for Aspose.OMR 26.1.0. Completely undeclared dependency.
confirmed_root_causes.psd: Newtonsoft.Json present in net5.0+ nuspec groups but absent from .NETStandard2.0 group. _match_framework_group() selected ns2.0 exclusively.
confirmed_root_causes.ocr: Aspose.Drawing.Common NOT declared in any nuspec group for Aspose.OCR 26.4.0. Completely undeclared dependency.

phase_b_investigation.prior_diagnosis_correction: Prior sprint notes claimed the fix was in extractor.py (resolved-libs population). This was INCORRECT. The actual gap is upstream in resolve_dependencies() which only processes the best-matching TFM group, plus packages that are truly undeclared in any group.

changes._collect_all_tfm_deps: New function: collects deps from ALL TFM groups in nuspec (union, deduplicated). Fixes packages that declare runtime deps only in net5.0+ groups.
changes.include_all_tfm_groups: New parameter for resolve_dependencies(). When True at depth=1, uses _collect_all_tfm_deps instead of _parse_dependencies. Transitive deps always use normal TFM matching.
changes.extra_packages: New field in DependencyResolution model. Allows YAML configs to declare packages that must be downloaded even though they are not in any nuspec group.
changes.discovery_sweep_changes: Now passes include_all_tfm_groups=True to resolve_dependencies(). Downloads and includes extra_packages in dep_nupkg_paths before extraction.

psd.fix_applied: include_all_tfm_groups=True (Newtonsoft.Json now resolved from net5.0+ group)
psd.new_blocker: Aspose.JavaAttributes Version=1.0.0.0 - internal Aspose assembly NOT on NuGet

ocr.new_blocker: Aspose.AI.LLM Version=25.12.0.0 - internal Aspose assembly NOT on NuGet

family_status_changes.yaml_change: extra_packages: [Aspose.Drawing.Common] added; comment updated; remains discovery_only
